cohort: Pregnant women at term, scheduled for cesarean sections, with single anterior wall or lower uterine segment myomas
finding: Cesarean myomectomy in patients with single anterior wall and lower uterine segment myomas does not cause increased perioperative morbidity and can be considered safe.
